digest.component_or_area: test suite reliability oracles (snapshot fetch stall abort, ACLI subprocess timeout)
propositions: test_slow_but_progressing_remote_is_not_aborted uses production-scale 10s low-speed window and 15s loopback server, consuming 15+ seconds per matrix cell despite contract being throughput-based not elapsed-time-based

test_read_retried_then_terminal uses production 1s call timeout plus real backoff sleeps across three child processes, consuming ~9s despite contract being exact retry schedule and process cleanup verification

Injected short test-only windows (1s stall, 0.1s call/grace/drain) with real loopback/subprocess execution and polling-based cleanup must replace production-scale timeouts while preserving all semantic contracts and process/socket integrity
Production defaults for timeout, stall, grace, drain, attempt count, and backoff schedule must remain unchanged in code and configuration
Both test modules must complete in low single-digit seconds without brittle wall-clock pass thresholds or runner changes
